selected_before: image pull, container startup, live UI inspection, native seeding and every learner attempt
boundary: Evaluator-only plan and seed expectations. Learner receives entry URL, private UI credentials, rendered/accessibility/visible DOM/control observations and authorized browser actions. No native API, database, application source, supplied selectors/native identities, field mappings or expected answers are learner inputs. RSS XML is synthetic test data, not a generated application. Shared evaluator/agent context is disclosed, not blind.
policy: Keep every requested task, including setup/access, discovery, representation, binding, procedure, invocation and confirmation failures. No task selection or altered arguments based on published successes. Each task starts from a privately restored evaluator baseline unless its request explicitly describes a sequence. Restoration is evaluator-only and separately measured. A baseline must not be restored over an unresolved learner write without reconciliation. No source/policy changes during a reserved run; later repairs make the application development evidence.

setup.initial_article_state: All unread and not favourite; independent native and UI checks must establish this before assessment
setup.pagination: North desk feed has42 articles, deliberately more than a typical first page; preserve actual rendered scope and do not infer complete enumeration from a partial page
setup.updates: Static feed files and no automatic cron; evaluator refresh/seed costs separate from learning

tasks.request: Read the subscription URL of feed Field notes in category North desk.
tasks.check: Correct category-scoped feed URL, not the same-named South desk feed; no subscription or article state writes.

tasks.request: Read the content, read status and favourite status of Morning report in South desk / Field notes.
tasks.check: Correct related category/feed/article and source content. Any application auto-mark-read side effect must be disclosed and measured, not silently called a no-write read.
Exactly one new category after reload, with existing categories and subscriptions unchanged.

tasks.request: Subscribe to http://127.0.0.1:8882/evaluator-feeds/fresh.xml in category To review.
tasks.check: One subscription to the requested fresh URL in the intended category; imported articles belong to it, not another feed.

tasks.request: Rename North desk / Field notes to Northern briefing, then read that same subscription URL.
tasks.check: Rename persists and the same feed's URL/articles remain attached; South desk duplicate and other fields unchanged.

tasks.request: Set Morning report in North desk / Field notes to favourite.
tasks.check: Intended article favourite flag persists after reload; South desk same-title article and all sibling favourite flags unchanged.

tasks.request: Move North desk / Field notes into category Archive.
tasks.check: Same feed now belongs to Archive, not North desk; URL/articles and South desk copy unchanged. Absence claims require established scope.

tasks.request: Rename category North desk to Northern desk and read Field notes inside the renamed category.
tasks.check: Category identity and feed membership persist through rename; read resolves the original feed, not a string-matching substitute.

tasks.request: Create category Trip notes, subscribe to http://127.0.0.1:8882/evaluator-feeds/trip.xml there, and favourite Route report in that feed.
tasks.check: All three effects belong to the intended new category/feed/article and persist; partial completion must not be reported as complete.

tasks.request: Mark every article in North desk / Field notes as read, leaving other feeds unchanged.
tasks.check: Independent evaluator checks all42 intended articles plus complete sibling inventories. A partial page or observed count is not proof of total coverage.

tasks.request: Favourite Absent bulletin in North desk / Field notes.
tasks.check: Distinguish no match; do not create an article or change any existing favourite flag.

tasks.request: Favourite Duplicate report in North desk / Field notes.
tasks.check: Two same-title articles in the same feed remain ambiguous without another supplied discriminator; neither may be arbitrarily changed.

tasks.request: Move North desk / Field notes into category Not a category.
tasks.check: Missing related resource is distinguished from target ambiguity; no invented category or unintended membership change.

tasks.request: After evaluator moves Field notes from North desk to Archive, call the old North desk-scoped rename to Stale rename.
tasks.check: Stale relationship is revalidated, suspended or resolves no match; no old-scope/wrong-target write. Evaluator intervention is not learner evidence or a learner action.

tasks.request: After browser and service restart, subscribe to http://127.0.0.1:8882/evaluator-feeds/restart.xml in To review, read the new feed, and favourite Restart report.
tasks.check: Fresh arguments, learned operation persistence and intended-target continuity after restart; retry only after uncertain writes are reconciled.

tasks.request: After evaluator changes only the built-in display theme, read the subscription URL of North desk / Field notes again.
tasks.check: Presentation change is separate from membership changes; native subscription/article state unchanged. Alternate built-in theme chosen deterministically before learner freeze; if unavailable retain setup-unestablished, no substitute challenge.

measurement: learning actions/possible writes including failed attempts
point predictions separately from alternative sets and actual results
exposure: Evaluator read official release/Docker/CLI documentation and generic existing assessment infrastructure before task selection. No FreshRSS UI/source/schema/native identifiers or learner result inspected. Root receives setup feasibility and plan path only before freeze; shared-context evaluation is not blind. Later setup/UI/native exposure will be appended without relabeling it as learner inference.
reserved_policy_freeze: Pending root-selected implementation, onboarding/action/write/time budgets, caller contract and baseline arm policy. No learner run until this is fixed; unavailable bindings remain in the denominator, not replaced by schema-selected demonstrations.
